title: An escape room that listens
summary:
Two conversation-driven Roblox games joined the community list, which also got some overdue pruning.

Aiko AI: With You Til The End joined the Games project list. The Roblox escape room has an autonomous AI character whose emotional state responds to what players say.

Convince the Weird Maid to Let You Leave the House joined the Games list. Players try to persuade an AI-driven maid to let them out before her “freakiness” meter reaches 100%. A fairly specific deadline.

The project directory also got a working Mindcraft web-game link, an updated Irina link, and fewer duplicate listings.
